name: Elathain's Soulraid
inspire: Inspire each friendly fighter at the start of the second battle round. Uninspire each friendly fighter at the start of the third battle round.

reactions.name: Flood Tide
reactions.rulesText: In the first battle round, immediately after an enemy fighter's melee Attack, give the attacker a Stagger token.

reactions.name: High Tide
reactions.rulesText: In the second battle round, friendly fighters have +1 Move.

reactions.name: Ebb Tide
reactions.rulesText: In the third battle round, friendly fighters' melee weapons (excluding Upgrades) have Grapple ({icon:grapple}).

abilities.name: Riptide Harpoon
abilities.trigger: Use this immediately after picking Tammael to Charge.
abilities.flavorText: Even a lowly Thrall such as Tammael is trained to fight with the fury of a surging wave.
abilities.rulesText: That fighter's melee weapons (excluding Upgrades) have +1 Attack dice for that Charge.

abilities.name: Soul Harvest
abilities.trigger: Use this immediately after an enemy fighter is slain by your leader ({icon:leader}) with a non-Upgrade weapon if a friendly Tammael is slain.
abilities.flavorText: It is through stolen souls that the Idoneth sustain their cursed civilisation.
abilities.rulesText: Raise that friendly Tammael and place them in a starting hex in friendly territory.

abilities.name: Ethersea Predators
abilities.trigger: Use this immediately after a friendly Idoneth ({icon:idoneth}) uses a Core ability.
abilities.flavorText: It's always the one you don't see that gets you.
abilities.rulesText: Push each friendly minion ({icon:minion}) 1 hex closer to that fighter.

abilities.name: Phantasmal Forms
abilities.flavorText: Even Akhelian nobles such as Fuirann will use illusion and trickery to avoid the brute enemy.
abilities.rulesText: Immediately after the Determine Success step of a successful Attack that targets a friendly Fuirann, that friendly Fuirann can use Stand Fast. You can only use this ability once per battle round.

playstyle: Five Idoneth raiders of middling durability whose power ebbs and flows with the tide. In the first round, enemies who make melee Attacks are Staggered, punishing anyone who strikes first. In the second round the warband Inspires and gains +1 Move for a fast assault, and in the third round it Uninspires but its melee weapons gain Grapple. Ensnaring ranged attacks, minions that drift toward Idoneth after Core abilities and a leader whose kills raise Tammael support a game plan of weathering the opening, then striking hard in round two.
